mode: PRODUCTION (pack only) — scheduled/unattended run, no reel-canary call made
hookText: The pothole that did not flatten your tire may still have cost you.
ctaText: Hit a bad one lately? Send this to someone who did.
onScreenTextPolicy: burned-in captions only via ffmpeg subtitle filter — never generated in-frame (Seedance/Higgsfield cannot spell; M10 preflight blocks generated text)
standingNegativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

storyboardBeats.narration: The pothole that did not flatten your tire may still have cost you.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Extreme slow-motion macro, a car tire compressing into a pothole edge, asphalt texture, dust and small debris kicked up, harsh midday sun, shallow depth of field, cinematic automotive commercial look, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Impact can bend a wheel, knock out alignment, or bruise the sidewall from the inside — where nothing shows.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Macro close-up of a bent wheel rim resting on a shop stand beside an alignment rack laser line, cool shop lighting, slow push-in, texture-forward metal detail, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: The tell is new pulling, new shaking, or a slow leak that starts days later.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Extreme macro of a tire sidewall bulge, rubber texture stretched and distorted, raking side light to emphasize the deformity, slow rotate, moody garage lighting, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: None of that shows on a walk-around. It shows up on the road.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Interior POV from the driver's seat, road ahead through the windshield, subtle handheld camera vibration, daylight, no visible driver hands or face, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Hit a bad one lately? Send this to someone who did. Nick's Tire and Auto — link in bio.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Wide shot of a tire shop garage bay interior, bay door partially open to daylight, tools racked in the background, no readable signage or branding in frame, warm end-of-day light, static hold, 9:16 vertical framing
